- **RoofLink**: $120/user/month flat rate, 7-step workflow, SalesRabbit/Roofle ecosystem
- **Rooftops.ai**: $12/mo Pro, $55/mo Team, AI Employees at $199/mo (waitlist), 1 free report

- Updated Rooftops.ai White-Glove Consulting description (now described as 5-week program, 4 spots/month)
- Added JobNimbus "Measurements" product page and "Peak Performance 2025" report
